answer: Sybil resistance comes from requiring each identity to complete a Wesolowski VDF: a long chain of sequential modular squarings whose next input depends on the previous output. An attacker may provision many apparent clones, but cannot compress each chain by distributing its dependent steps across GPUs; every clone therefore incurs a strict physical delay. The onyx raven orchard network can verify proofs efficiently while preserving this time bottleneck.
